title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to Visit Jharkhand on October 10
body_text:
The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Deoghar, Jharkhand, on October 10, 2026.
During his visit, the Vice-President will grace the 2nd Convocation of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Deoghar.
The Vice-President will also visit the Sainya Sampark Mela at BBMT Hospital, Deoghar, Jharkhand.
